# Security & Input Validation Checklist: Kanban Task Management

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of security and input-validation
requirements in the Taskify Kanban feature specification and design artifacts.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are security/validation requirements enumerated for every mutating user action (create project, create/move/assign/comment task)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are server-side input-validation requirements stated as mandatory (and client-side validation explicitly non-authoritative)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is fail-closed behavior (reject invalid input by default, no partial write or data corruption) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are allowlist validation rules (valid status enum, valid assignee, valid identity) explicitly specified? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are attribution/audit requirements defined for all mutating actions, not just stated as a goal? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Are maximum length limits quantified in the spec itself (not only the data model) for project names, task titles, descriptions, and comments? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "clear error message" (FR-012) specified concretely — e.g., field-level detail and stable error codes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the identity-attribution mechanism (how the active user is transmitted and validated) documented in the spec, not only in plan/contracts? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the four status values defined as an exact, unambiguous allowlist with no synonyms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Access Control & Permissions

- [ ] CHK010 - Are permission requirements defined per action (who may move a task, assign it, or comment)? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "all users share the same permissions" assumption validated against the Product Manager vs Engineer role distinction? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are access-control requirements specified for notifications (can a user read or mark-read another user's notifications)? [Gap, contracts/api-contracts.md]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the absence of authentication explicitly scoped as a phase-1 deviation with a documented remediation requirement? [Assumption, Plan §Complexity Tracking]

## Input Validation Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 - Are validation requirements defined for every input surface, including query parameters and the identity header (not just names/titles/comments)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are validation rules for the optional task description (length, trimming) explicitly specified? [Coverage, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are trimming/normalization rules (leading/trailing whitespace) consistently specified for all text inputs? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Cases & Failure Handling

- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements specified for safe rendering of user-supplied text (stored-XSS prevention) in the board UI? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are concurrency/conflict requirements specified for simultaneous edits (e.g., two users moving the same task)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the validation-failure response shape (error envelope) consistently specified across all endpoints? [Consistency, contracts/api-contracts.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 - Are secret-handling requirements (connection strings, no hardcoded secrets) explicitly stated for the Postgres/Aspire configuration? [Gap, Constitution]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is data-at-rest encryption specified, or explicitly deferred with rationale? [Gap, Constitution]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are dependency scanning / vulnerability requirements specified for the .NET/NuGet supply chain? [Gap, Constitution]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the spoofing risk of client-selected identity acknowledged with acceptance criteria or a remediation path? [Assumption, Spec §FR-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
